name: What are the benefits of building a fourplex compared to a single-family home?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of building a fourplex compared to a single-family home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a fourplex offers several advantages over a single-family home, primarily related to potential income generation and efficient land use. Owners can live in one unit and rent out the others, providing a consistent revenue stream that can offset mortgage payments. Fourplexes also contribute to housing density, making efficient use of urban land. From an investment perspective, they can offer a strong return on investment and portfolio diversification, while providing multiple affordable housing options within a single structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fourplexes offer income generation potential by allowing owners to rent out multiple units, making efficient use of land compared to a single-family home.
